other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage in cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: Applying a transformation (like StandardScaler) to the entire training dataset before splitting it into cross-validation folds leaks statistical information from the validation folds into the training folds, resulting in overly optimistic cross-validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing target label encoding
other_failure_modes.description: LightGBM requires multiclass target labels to be contiguous integers starting from 0. If the dataset's target classes are not 0-indexed or have gaps (like in the satimage dataset), passing them directly to LightGBM causes a fatal execution error.

summary: The agent establishes a basic modeling pipeline but fails to clean the data, engineer features, or properly encode the target variable, which leads to a fatal execution error in LightGBM due to non-contiguous class labels.
